remarks: The sun is out, the birds are chirping & the daffodils are on their way. Spring is almost here, & what better way to celebrate her arrival than w/ 11 Ludlow Manor. Unassumingly delightful & tucked along a highly coveted street in East Norwalk, this 3-bedroom, 2 bath Cape blends classic charm w/ thoughtful updates, creating a space that feels comfortable & timeless. From the moment you step inside, hardwood floors run throughout, adding warmth & character to each room. The main level offers the ease & comfort of a primary bedroom. Nearby, the formal living room w/ wood burning fireplace is perfect for the winter months, the office w/ sliding doors provides the perfect place for working from home, reading, or enjoying a quiet retreat that brings the outside in. The heart of the home is a beautiful kitchen featuring granite countertops & stainless-steel appliances ideal for preparing meals, gathering w/ loved ones, & creating everyday moments. Upstairs, 2 additional bedrooms are centered around a full bathroom that connects to a walk-in closet. The lower level offers exciting extension w/ a sports den & dedicated gym area, perfect for game nights, workouts, or simply unwinding at the end of the day. The outside deck & grilling area overlook a fully fenced yard with garden area & mature plantings. W/ coastal living at your fingertips-scenic beaches, marinas, nearby country clubs, restaurants & shops, this isn't just any old neighborhood home - it's the destination of a lifetime.

facts.laundryLoc: Lower Level and hooks-ups in Kitchen
